criterion_fired: Criterion 3 (Competition), Criterion 4 (Next Steps Specificity), Criterion 5 (Evidence Standard)
suggested_change: Criterion 4 should clarify that next steps must include: specific contact owner (name or '[TBD]'), concrete ask (not open-ended question), and explicit date/deadline. Criterion 5 should require direct quotes from prospect voice only, flagging sales summary language separately. Criterion 3 should require evidence of prospect evaluation of at least 2 named competitors, not assumption of competitive set.
